notes.scope: Every signature and extension test class of dss-xades (src/test/java/eu/europa/esig/dss/xades/{signature,extension}, files ending in Test.java, abstract bases excluded) at the tag of the current DSS release, each classified once. `xades dss-catalogue` fails on a class this file does not list, on a listed class the release no longer has, and on a case, capability or reason it does not know.
notes.covered: The same signature form at the same levels runs in the harness: `lifecycle/` cases create B-B with one implementation and take it to B-T, B-LT, B-LTA and a renewed archive with both, each step validated by the side that did not make it; `creation/` cases are documents xml-sec creates and DSS validates; `dss-form/` cases are documents DSS creates as its tests do and xml-sec validates.
notes.unsupported: xml-sec cannot create this form: each named capability is missing. Shared property construction belongs to the signature primitives the producer composes.
notes.not-applicable: The class tests DSS's own behaviour, not a signature form: its API, its validation policy over a PKI scenario, or its handling of an input or serialization choice.

capabilities.manifest-signature: a signature whose reference covers a ds:Manifest of the signed objects
capabilities.signer-role: SignerRoleV2 with claimed roles or signed assertions
capabilities.data-object-format-details: DataObjectFormat Description, ObjectIdentifier and Encoding beyond MimeType
capabilities.custom-references: references and transforms the caller chooses: XPath, XPath Filter 2.0, XPointer, base64, an enveloped transform alone, a reference to an arbitrary element, comments kept
capabilities.custom-objects: additional ds:Object content the caller supplies
capabilities.xslt-transform: an XSLT reference transform at creation
capabilities.custom-prefixes: namespace prefixes the caller chooses for ds: and xades:
capabilities.signature-placement: placing the signature element at an XPath location
capabilities.no-signing-certificate: an XMLDSig signature without a signing certificate, and its augmentation
capabilities.plain-ecdsa: the BSI plain ECDSA signature methods
capabilities.ts101903-format: ETSI TS 101 903 V1.1.1 and V1.2.2 namespaces and the signing certificate properties before EN 319 132
capabilities.ts101903-level: the TS 101 903 levels C, X, XL and A
capabilities.evidence-record: an evidence record as an unsigned property
capabilities.validation-data-refresh: adding fresher validation data to a signature that already meets B-LT; xml-sec adds only the data a signature lacks

reasons.dss-api: behaviour of the DSS service API: parameter validation and its exceptions, re-initialised or atomic calls, identifier providers, the document extender class, external signature values, digest documents in place of content, TSA failures
reasons.pki-scenario: DSS's validation policy over a PKI condition: cross-certification, self-signed or expired certificates, revocation freshness, trust services and anchors, OCSP responder handling, AIA retrieval, revocation source accounting, a PKI hashed with SHA-1 or SHA-3
reasons.dss-input-handling: DSS's handling of a particular input: a non-XML or HTML document, encodings, a missing XML declaration, empty or duplicate Ids, file names with special characters or none
reasons.dss-serialization: DSS's own indentation of what it writes and of what it augments; xml-sec reading DSS's indented signature is covered by dss-form/pretty-print
reasons.stored-document: DSS augments a document of its own test resources; the corpus comparison validates those resources
reasons.deprecated-algorithm: RIPEMD-160, which xml-sec verifies only behind its legacy-algorithms feature and does not create in the harness
